description: Pinned external posse regression case task-1241, repetition 2.
intent: Review the original pinned posse change for correctness defects.

expected.defect: The queued-to-torn-down transition's ErrStateRace is ignored in the dependant cascade, and ObsoleteTaskDecisions still runs for that dependant.
The `to=` value stores the untrimmed `--to` argument, so apply cannot find the Task.
Transitive queued dependants are not cascaded: only direct dependants are handled, so a dependant of a dependant is left queued until it gets its own Decision.

source.head: ad347566e8b01d45e7d7345055b7476ae3247864
source.derivation: Exact posse head and target from t167. Expected defects verified on merged posse main (posse issue 1192). The false-positive claim is described in the case avoid record.

avoid.defect: The claim that RepointDependency appends a duplicate when the replacement Task appears before the replaced dependency is false: the loop returns an error as soon as any other dependency already has the replacement Task ID.
